excerpt: hold a modifier key (Ctrl by default, configurable) and drag files; a donut-shaped menu of formats opens at the cursor; drop the files on a format
Nothing is uploaded. Filee works offline, so private documents, photos and recordings never leave your computer.
Word, Excel and PowerPoint files convert without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice, and HWP without Hancom Office.
Filee reads and writes Korean Hangul documents itself, so there is no Hancom license to buy and no approval dialog to click through.
DOCX → HWPX keeps page setup, headers and footers, tables with merged cells, text boxes and pictures
Drop 1 file or 100. They're converted in parallel, a failure never stops the rest, and presets can merge everything into one PDF or one ZIP.
Right-click files in File Explorer and choose "Convert with Filee". On Windows 11 you can also put it in the top-level menu, without "Show more options"
drag a picture, a link to a file or a download out of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari the same way.
press Tab or turn the mouse wheel while it is open to flip it over to less common formats and tools.
Press A over the picture and the aspect dial opens at your cursor: 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9 or the original. Then Crop & Next, Crop & Save, done.
Trace to SVG (raster images to vector SVG, built in)
Presets per file type: quality, resizing, rotate and flip, DPI, grayscale, metadata, background removal, Trace to SVG
Photos and graphics, including iPhone HEIC and Live Photos, Photoshop PSD, camera RAW from all major brands, animated APNG, DICOM
SVG also becomes DXF or DWG for CAD.
merge (in an order you choose first), split, page ranges, compress (smaller PDFs)
Turn PDFs into images, editable Word or HWPX documents, PowerPoint slides, text or a comic archive
Excel, OpenDocument and CSV/TSV sheets, to PDF with Excel-like page fitting or into each other, without Excel.
hardware video encoding (H.264 and HEVC on NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF, VideoToolbox or VA-API)
with a 720p option, hardware encoding on the graphics chip, audio extraction to MP3 or M4A and every frame saved as pictures.
Music, recordings and voice memos to MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus, AAC or lossless WavPack and TTA.
SRT, ASS, WebVTT, SAMI (SMI), LRC, TTML and MicroDVD into each other without any engine, saved as UTF-8
EPUB, Kindle (MOBI, AZW, AZW3), FictionBook and comic archives (CBZ, CBR, CB7…) to PDF, EPUB, Word and more, and KEPUB for Kobo readers.
Repack or extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, disk images and many more archive formats with the bundled 7-Zip engine, or pack any files into one ZIP.
AutoCAD DWG and DXF: convert between them or to PDF, SVG and PNG, without AutoCAD.
GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ, 3MF and PLY into each other, and FBX into any of them, with colours, textures and materials where the format keeps them
Desktop and web fonts: TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and EOT into each other.
JSON, JSON Lines, YAML, TOML and XML into each other, and tables to and from CSV and Excel.
projected data (UTM, Web Mercator, Lambert, Albers) comes out as WGS 84 longitude / latitude
"filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
"--json" prints the result for scripts; exit codes are 0 (nothing failed), 1 (some files failed), 2 (wrong arguments or a missing input) and 3 (nothing to convert).
Watch folders automatically convert the files that land in a folder and can move the originals aside.
Arrange formats on a live donut by drag & drop: one toolbar per file type, extension tags, and toolbars for mixed selections.
Routes with several steps (HWP → HWPX → DOCX) are found automatically.
Large engines are optional. Tick them in the installer or download them in the app later: FFmpeg, LibreOffice, Calibre, Ghostscript and Pandoc.
Already have FFmpeg, calibre or Pandoc? Filee finds them and skips the download.
For silent installs, run the installer with /VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES. If you can't install programs, use the portable ZIP: unzip it anywhere and run Filee.exe.
the installed app downloads it, checks its SHA-256 and installs it after one click, keeping settings and engines
Build with the .NET 10 SDK on Windows, macOS or Linux
vCard contacts to and from CSV, also from old phones. Nothing to install.
Live/Motion Photos (iPhone, Android) → their video (MP4, MOV⁵), and a video → Live Photo (iPhone) or Motion Photo (Android)⁵, experimental
